title: gymnosporia senegalensis subsp. europaea
intro: Gymnosporia senegalensis subsp. europaea, commonly known as the Black Stinkwood, is a plant species that belongs to the Celastraceae family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Gymnosporia senegalensis subsp. europaea include analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been reported to include compounds like quercetin, kaempferol, and isorhapontigenin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
